title: clematis ochotensis
intro: Clematis ochotensis, commonly known as the Ochotense Clematis, is a species of flowering plant in the buttercup family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Clematis ochotensis include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and potentially alleviating symptoms of anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
